report: At 2023-10-15 23:00 UTC, humanize.naturaldate(datetime.datetime(2023, 10, 16, 17, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone(datetime.timedelta(hours=11)))) returns 'tomorrow'. In that datetime's own timezone it is already 16 October, so it should be 'today'.

hide.line: # AEDT (+11): now is Oct 16 10:00, future is Oct 16 17:00 => today
# CEST (+2): now is Oct 16 01:00, future is Oct 16 08:00 => today

issue_test:
import datetime as dt

from freezegun import freeze_time

import humanize


@freeze_time("2023-10-15 23:00:00+00:00")
def test_naturaldate_aware_plus_11():
    plus_11 = dt.timezone(dt.timedelta(hours=11))
    assert humanize.naturaldate(dt.datetime(2023, 10, 16, 17, 0, tzinfo=plus_11)) == "today"

import datetime as dt

from freezegun import freeze_time

import humanize

P2 = dt.timezone(dt.timedelta(hours=2))
P11 = dt.timezone(dt.timedelta(hours=11))
P530 = dt.timezone(dt.timedelta(hours=5, minutes=30))


@freeze_time("2023-10-15 23:00:00+00:00")
def test_aware_values_use_their_own_today():
    assert humanize.naturalday(dt.datetime(2023, 10, 16, 8, 0, tzinfo=P2)) == "today"
    assert humanize.naturalday(dt.datetime(2023, 10, 15, 20, 0, tzinfo=P11)) == "yesterday"
    assert humanize.naturaldate(dt.datetime(2023, 10, 16, 1, 0, tzinfo=P530)) == "today"
    assert humanize.naturalday(dt.datetime(2023, 10, 17, 9, 0, tzinfo=P11)) == "tomorrow"
